tasks.subject: Task 1: DocState data model + workspace migration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the sealed `DocState` payload to `Manifest` and make the whole workspace compile.

**Files:** crates/inkapp-core/src/manifest.rs (add DocState, Manifest.state, derive Default, init recover_regions); add `..Default::default()` to every literal `Manifest {…}` in components/notice.rs + tests across inkapp-core and inkapp-harness; new crates/inkapp-core/tests/doc_state.rs.

**Verify:** `cargo test -p inkapp-core -p inkapp-harness`

```json:metadata
{"files":["crates/inkapp-core/src/manifest.rs","crates/inkapp-core/tests/doc_state.rs"],"verifyCommand":"cargo test -p inkapp-core -p inkapp-harness","acceptanceCriteria":["DocState serde round-trip","manifest without state key deserializes","workspace tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Stepper component (proof consumer)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Ship stateful `Stepper` whose read/decode use the carried base, not the prop.

**Files:** new crates/inkapp-core/src/components/stepper.rs; crates/inkapp-core/src/components/mod.rs (`pub mod stepper;`); new crates/inkapp-core/tests/stepper_state.rs.

**Keystone:** prop=9, carried base=5, one stroke → vec![6].

**Verify:** `cargo test -p inkapp-core --test stepper_state`

```json:metadata
{"files":["crates/inkapp-core/src/components/stepper.rs","crates/inkapp-core/src/components/mod.rs","crates/inkapp-core/tests/stepper_state.rs"],"verifyCommand":"cargo test -p inkapp-core --test stepper_state","acceptanceCriteria":["stateful hooks","read=base+increments","keystone base over prop"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Loop-level carried-base proof
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Through App::step, prove decode uses the carried base after Model moved on.

**Files:** new crates/inkapp-core/tests/stepper_loop.rs.

**Acceptance:** render at 5; set app.model=9 with no re-render; step one stroke → cycle.decoded == vec![6] (not vec![10]).

**Verify:** `cargo test -p inkapp-core --test stepper_loop`

```json:metadata
{"files":["crates/inkapp-core/tests/stepper_loop.rs"],"verifyCommand":"cargo test -p inkapp-core --test stepper_loop","acceptanceCriteria":["decoded vec![6] via loop, carried base wins"]}
```
